inputs.name: sshd_port
inputs.description: Port sshd listens on, which the sshd jail bans on. When null, ssh_port. Set it when a port forward or NAT sits between Conn3x and the hosts.

inputs.name: bantime
inputs.description: Seconds an address stays banned. -1 bans it for good.

inputs.name: findtime
inputs.description: Window in seconds in which maxretry failures lead to a ban.

inputs.name: maxretry
inputs.description: Failures within findtime that ban an address.

inputs.name: ignoreip
inputs.description: Addresses and networks never banned, such as ["192.168.1.0/24"]. Loopback is always on the list.

inputs.name: banaction
inputs.description: fail2ban action that bans an address, from /etc/fail2ban/action.d, such as "nftables", "firewallcmd-rich-rules" or "ufw".

inputs.name: jails
inputs.type:
map(object({
    enabled  = optional(bool, true)
    port     = optional(string)
    filter   = optional(string)
    logpath  = optional(string)
    backend  = optional(string)
    maxretry = optional(number)
  }))
inputs.description: Extra jails, by name, such as { nginx-http-auth = { port = "http,https", logpath = "/var/log/nginx/error.log" } }. filter defaults to the jail's name.
